data.gender_notes: Vanshika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vanshika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vansh' which means 'descent' or 'lineage', and 'Shri' which means 'Goddess'. The name Vanshika signifies the descent of the Goddess of Prosperity. It is believed that the name bestows prosperity, happiness, and good fortune upon the child. The name Vanshika carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vanshika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Vanshika is deeply spiritual in origin and is believed to bring the blessings of the Goddess of Prosperity and Fertility. It is a name that is often given to children in the hope of a prosperous and happy future.
data.etymology: Vanshika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vanshika total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
